scope: Syria medical discovery — Damascus University Faculty of Human Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Damascus University's official Faculty of Human Medicine Telegram channel published current 2025/26 preparatory-year examination and administrative notices in June 2026, including notices for students assigned to Human Medicine.

Syria's official news agency reported in May 2026 that Damascus University's Faculty of Human Medicine participated with the Arab Board of Health Specializations in a scientific meeting addressing postgraduate training quality, governance and assessment.

The Syrian Ministries of Higher Education and Health ran a unified 2025/26 selection process for medical-college graduates across Syrian public and private universities for approved training and qualification programmes; this is graduate training evidence, not undergraduate admission evidence.
